basic_profile.bio: ModSeeker1998 is a 25-year-old gaming enthusiast based in Krakow, Poland. They have recently completed a degree in History and are passionate about historical strategy games, which aligns well with their love for Hearts of Iron IV. Outside of gaming, they enjoy tending to their collection of Adenium plants. Typically, they are active on Reddit during late evenings, after working hours at a local museum where they are a tour guide. They are currently single and often spend weekends exploring new mods for their favorite games or relaxing with friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: ModSeeker1998 has a strong background in European history, having studied it extensively during their university years. They are particularly knowledgeable about the interwar period and World War I and II, which they often explore through strategy games. They have self-taught themselves modding basics to experiment with game modifications.
